scenarios.title: Access granted outside Privilege
scenarios.say: Someone grants access by hand on the platform. The reconcile finds it, a nightly run finds it again, and the reaper cannot remove it because it was never a grant.

steps.say: diego.ruiz gets read on storefront-web for two hours by auto-approval.
An administrator raises diego.ruiz to admin on the repository by hand, and gives hana.sato write on edge-infra. Neither goes through Privilege.
The reconcile compares the platform with the receipts and flags both.
A day later the nightly reconcile runs by itself. The read grant has expired, but the hand-made admin access stays: after the reaper, drift remains.
